parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The response language. Valid values: zh (Chinese) and en (English). Default value: zh.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the rule.

parameters.name: LimitApp
parameters.description: The name of the source application.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The microservice namespace to which the application belongs.

parameters.name: Threshold
parameters.description: The concurrency threshold for the isolation rule.
